For executives who greenlit seven-figure AI budgets expecting productivity gains, this is a direct hit to ROI. You deployed the model. You trained the team. But the data layer underneath was never rebuilt for the way AI actually consumes and produces information.

This is not a technology problem. It is an architecture problem.
